name: Sawabe Akemi
source:
She lives in building B with her husband and son who goes to kindergarten.

She is said to be a former delinquent, and although her words and actions are violent, she is a compassionate person.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bmwp.htmll]official site[/url]]
